name: Voxenfelle Academy: School Festival Diary
source:
The kingdom of Astralena has been full of strife recently, what with age-old class divides and the political persecution of voidpacts. At the esteemed Voxenfelle Academy, nobles, commoners, and voidpacts alike have come to study how to be a Hunter...

... But for now, they have the school festival to worry about! With only 2 weeks to prepare, the second years need your help to make it a success. Build stalls and play their minigames, unlock student endings, and watch them juggle homework, drama, and takoyaki balls in Voxenfelle Academy: School Festival Diary.

[From [url=https://shuttlefrog.itch.io/vfasfd]itch.io[/url]]
